item.title: EplayerX 1.2.46
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 改善播放器 2 播放部分 HEVC 视频时的起播与拖动稳定性，减少时间戳异常造成的卡顿和画面丢失。 - 优化播放器 2 的缓冲就绪判断，减少视频已准备好后仍等待数据的情况。 - 改善连续拖动、切换音轨和播放缓存管理的稳定性。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Improved Player 2 startup and seeking with some HEVC videos, reducing stalls and missing frames caused by irregular timestamps. - Improved Player 2 buffer readiness checks to reduce waiting after video is ready to play. - Improved stability when seeking repeatedly, switching audio tracks, and managing playback caches.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
